result.final_text:
## What this letter says

You had a breast screening mammogram (breast X-ray) on 16 September 2026. The clinic is calling you back for more tests.

Being called back does not mean you have cancer. Most women called back do not have cancer.

At your appointment you may have:
- More mammograms
- An ultrasound scan (sound wave pictures)
- A biopsy (a small sample of tissue for testing)

You will usually get most results on the same day. The visit may take up to 4 hours.

## What you need to do

1. Go to your appointment on Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00. It is at the Breast Assessment Clinic, Eastmoor Hospital.
2. You can bring a friend or family member with you.
3. If you cannot come, call 01632 960 733 as soon as possible.

## Dates and medicines

**Dates:**
- Breast screening mammogram: 16 September 2026
- Appointment at Breast Assessment Clinic: Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 11:00

**Medicines:**
No medicines listed in this letter.

## Questions to ask your doctor

- What will happen at my appointment?
- What do the different tests check for?
- How soon will I get all my results?

## When to get urgent help

The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
